notes: The for before a sacrifice is given to the appositive זֶבַח under rule 33, not to the object marker on הָאַיִל, because the ASV writes the ram bare and the preposition stands before the unmarked nominal — which is the clause rule 16's fourth family expressly hands back to rule 33.
also is the waw of וְעָשָׂה under rule 51's settled reading, written postpositively and so discontinuous rather than broken.
In סַל הַמַּצּוֹת the rectum is rendered anarthrously, so the article takes the single written the that English fronts (rule 29).
